prototypes.name: Questionnaire / Recommendation page
prototypes.description: The Every product quiz: intro, questions, reinforcement steps, loader and personalised results.

versions.title: Responsive intro, new motion and meal modal
versions.changes: Added a 1024px breakpoint: intro goes image-left/copy-right, question and reinforcement steps sit in a 544px column. Rebuilt step animations (x-axis blur, cross-over exit, softer easing), press scale on options, and progress that counts reinforcement steps. Loader now hands over to results automatically. Satisfaction step has a Continue button and a neutral default face. New goal, household and eater icons, copy updates, and the meal modal rebuilt to match the website's MealDetailModal (no reviews).

versions.title: Controls in the studio
versions.changes: Added studio.json so the studio can drive the quiz from its controls: start point (homepage, quiz, loader, results), results page A or B, bundle, and challenge. No change to the quiz itself.
